# proxmox_ha_groups (Data Source)

Lists legacy HA groups from `/cluster/ha/groups`. PVE 9 reports the endpoint as migrated; in that case `groups` is empty and `migrated` is true.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_ha_groups" "g" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

### Read-Only

- `groups` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--groups))
- `migrated` (Boolean)
